commands.command: pwd && rg --files -g 'build.py' -g 'tests/**' -g 'content/**' -g 'docs/**' -g 'index.html' | sort && git diff -- build.py tests
sed -n '1,260p' build.py && sed -n '261,520p' build.py && sed -n '1,320p' tests/test_s1.py

sed -n '321,760p' tests/test_s1.py && sed -n '1,200p' docs/assets/time.js && sed -n '1,260p' docs/index.html && find docs -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort | while read f; do printf '\n--- %s ---\n' "$f"; file "$f"; done

python3 -c 'from datetime import datetime; s=["２０２４-０２-０３T０４:０５:０６Z","٢٠٢٤-٠٢-٠٣T٠٤:٠٥:٠٦Z","2024-02-03T04:05:06Z"]; [(print(repr(x), end=" "), print(datetime.strptime(x, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))) if True else None for x in s]'

git --no-pager diff --no-ext-diff --unified=80 -- build.py tests/test_s1.py; git status --short --untracked-files=all; rg -n "TODO|FIXME|pass|external|Intl|title|first_text|ID_RE|post_files|time_element|install_output" build.py tests/test_s1.py
for d in /tmp /var/tmp /var/folders /dev /dev/shm .; do ls -ld "$d" 2>/dev/null || true; done; python3 -c 'import tempfile; print(tempfile.gettempdir())'

command -v node >/dev/null && TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati node -e 'const d=new Date("9999-12-31T23:59:59Z"); const pad=(v,w=2)=>String(v).padStart(w,"0"); console.log(d.toString()); console.log(`${pad(d.getFullYear(),4)}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`);' || true
